name: Others Year - Invalid Input Then Valid Year
goal: User selects 'Others', enters invalid year (e.g., 'abcd'), then valid year (2020), and downloads the letter.
constraints: User selects 'Others', enters invalid year, is re-prompted, then enters 2020. Chooses download. Tool returns webViewLink.

phases.description: Run setup workflow and confirm menuType is 'only years'.

phases.completionCriteria: Bot rejects input and re-prompts for year.
Bot triggers workflow and provides webViewLink.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
